content: <rss version="2.0"><channel><title>ESPN NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/</link><description>ESPN public league news</description><item><title>Spurs win 12th straight while sending Jazz to 12th straight loss</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909988</link><description>— Dylan Harper had 31 points and nine rebounds to rally the San Antonio Spurs to a 110-102 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday, giving them their 12th straight win, while sending the Jazz to a 12th straight loss.</description><pubDate>Mon, 16 Nov 2026 00:38:41 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909988.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>San Antonio Spurs vs. Utah Jazz: Game Highlights</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50496592/game-highlights</link><description>San Antonio Spurs vs. Utah Jazz: Game Highlights</description><pubDate>Mon, 16 Nov 2026 00:36:49 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/wsc/2026/1116/8df0dd5d-51f5-4e6e-96ff-ea8fe46c398b/8df0dd5d-51f5-4e6e-96ff-ea8fe46c398b.jpg" /></item><item><title>Which NBA players have the most triple-doubles of all time?</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/47987750/which-nba-players-most-triple-doubles-all</link><description>Russell Westbrook holds the NBA record for most triple-doubles in a career. See who else joins him on the list.</description><pubDate>Mon, 16 Nov 2026 00:41:31 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0220/r1617781_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Darius Garland scores 27 as Clippers run win streak over Hornets to 17 with 113-105 win</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909987</link><description>— Darius Garland scored 27 points, Max Strus had 14 off the bench and the Los Angeles Clippers beat the Charlotte Hornets for the 17th straight time with a 113-105 victory Sunday.</description><pubDate>Mon, 16 Nov 2026 00:20:35 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909987.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Luka Doncic scores 43, Lakers stretch winning streak to 8 with 131-123 win over Suns</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909986</link><description>— Luka Doncic scored 43 points and the Los Angeles Lakers stretched their winning streak to eight games by holding off the Phoenix Suns 131-123 on Sunday.</description><pubDate>Mon, 16 Nov 2026 00:06:35 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909986.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Celtics set franchise mark with 42-9 lead over Mavericks after one quarter</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50496245/celtics-set-franchise-mark-42-9-lead-mavericks-one-quarter</link><description>The Celtics led the Mavericks 42-9 at the end of the first quarter Sunday, the largest scoring margin in a quarter since 1987.</description><pubDate>Mon, 16 Nov 2026 00:33:13 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1116/r1746430_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
